To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we developed a sensitive and specific HPLC method with post-column photochemical oxidation and fluorimetric detection for determination of bisphophonates.

we have developed a new reversed-phase ion pair high-performance liquid chromatography method with post-column photochemical oxidation and fluorescence detection for determination of four bisphosphonate drugs.

the developed method is precise (mean relative standard deviation of less than 2.3%), sensitive (limit of detection at 1.2-3.3 nmol L(-)(1)), accurate, specific, inexpensive (low cost of reagents), rapid (approximately 13 min) for the determination of bisphophonic acids.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the development of a simple, precise, sensitive, specific and rapid HPLC method for the analysis of four important bisphosphonic acid drugs, which can be applied to the analysis in pharmaceutical dosage formulations and human urine samples.
the development of a sensitive and simple method for the determination of bisphophonates in pharmaceutical formulations and in urine samples.
the development and optimization of the HPLC method with a new post-column derivatization system for bisphosphonic acid analysis.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the developed method is a simple, sensitive, rapid, precise, accurate and inexpensive method for the determination of etronate, risonate and ibronate in human samples.
the proposed HPLC method has been successfully applied for the analysis of bisphosphonic acid in dosage formulations and in human urine.

the proposed method has been successfully applied to the analysis in human urine of etidronatedisodium, risedronatedisodium and ibandronatedisodium in the therapeutic concentration range, and the proposed HPLC method is a promising tool for the routine analysis of bisphosphonic acid in biological fluids and in pharmaceutical preparations.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
a sensitive, precise, accurate, rapid and inexpensive method for the analysis of bisphosphonic acid has been developed.
the proposed method is simple, sensitive and accurate for the analysis of bisphosphonic acid drugs in pharmaceutical formulations and in urine.

a sensitive, precise and accurate method has been developed and applied for the determination of etridronic acid (ETI) in pharmaceutical preparations, human urine, and for the simultaneous determination of alendronic acid, ibandronate acid and risedronic acids in pharmaceutical preparations.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the developed method is suitable for the determination of bisphophonates in biological samples.
the developed method is simple, sensitive and rapid, with the potential to be used in the determination of bisphosphate drugs in biological samples.
